name: Zukk'ash Infestation
summary: At Camp Mojache, Hadoken Swiftstrider suspects the Zukk'ash south of the gnolls are driving them into a frenzy. He sends you to the Writhing Deep to thin their numbers and return with twenty carapaces.

sections.title: The Foe South of the Gnolls
sections.body: Hadoken Swiftstrider believes insect-like creatures live south of the gnolls. Whether they can think matters little to him. If they drive the gnolls into a frenzy against Camp Mojache, they threaten the camp as much as the gnolls do. So you enter their home, the Writhing Deep, to thin their numbers. Bring back twenty Zukk'ash carapaces as proof, and tell Hadoken what you find.

sections.title: Hadoken's Verdict
sections.body: Hadoken Swiftstrider is pleased when you return. Only a full-scale invasion can end the Zukk'ash presence, but your work has bought Camp Mojache time to devise a proper strategy. The camp will study the carapaces and learn all it can about these creatures. The danger has grown far beyond what anyone expected.

faq.q: Who sends you after the Zukk'ash?
faq.answer: Hadoken Swiftstrider sends you from Camp Mojache in Feralas.
Hadoken believes the Zukk'ash are insect-like creatures south of the gnolls. Whether they can think matters little to him; he fears they may be driving the gnolls into a frenzy.
The Writhing Deep, home to the Zukk'ash, lies south of the gnolls.

faq.q: Why does Hadoken want Zukk'ash carapaces?
faq.answer: Hadoken wants the carapaces as proof of your work against the Zukk'ash.
